title: Jens Winther's piece from the IASJ Baltic cruise of 1996
summary: The IASJ toured ten Baltic countries by boat, and the piece Winther wrote was rehearsed aboard for the Rhythmic Conservatory opening.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Here’s – with an old friend of mine, Jens Winther, the 4 Elements.

This is from the IASJ, Baltic cruise, 1996. We went around the Baltic to 10 countries, on the boat, playing jam sessions. He wrote a piece. That was the opening of the Danish Rhythmic Conservatory, done at the end of the tour.
Rehearsed on the boat. I have pictures of him rehearsing on the boat.
He and I were in the BMI Jazz Composers Workshop together.
Serious guy. A little out, but serious.
